data.gender_notes: Keelia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Keila, meaning 'slender' or 'strong'. In Greek mythology, Keila was a goddess of the winds, associated with the swiftness and power of the wind. In Christianity, the name Keelia can symbolize the strength and resilience of faith. The name Keelia carries the meaning “Slender, strong” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Keelia usually hope their child will grow to embody slender, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Keelia total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
